body.score_note: Weighted score: high −12, medium −6, low −2 from 100. It measures only what is automatable (≈1/3 of WCAG): use it to track trends between releases, not as conformance.

findings.issue: 1 without an alt attribute (not even alt="").
findings.remediation: Add alt to every : descriptive text when it conveys information, alt="" when decorative. Same requirement for and .

findings.issue: 1 <button> with no accessible name (no text, aria-label or title).
findings.remediation: The accessible name comes from inner text, aria-label, title, or an inner image with alt. An empty control is invisible to screen readers.

findings.issue: 1 form fields with no associated <label> and no accessible name.
findings.remediation: Associate <label for="id"> (or wrap the field), or use aria-label. Applies to input, select and textarea.

findings.issue: Neither <main>/role="main" nor a skip link: no way to bypass repeated blocks.
findings.remediation: Add <main> (or role="main") and a "Skip to content" link as the first focus stop.

findings.issue: No status regions (aria-live/status/alert) detected on the page: dynamic messages will not be announced (4.1.3).
findings.remediation: Add role="status" or aria-live="polite" for toasts, save confirmations, search results (4.1.3).

body.limits: Automation ≈ one third of WCAG: this is an express filter, not a substitute for manual review (keyboard, screen reader, real contrast, audit rhyme).
